name: @anthropic-ai/claude-code-deps
//: Only packages the extracted tree actually resolves at runtime belong here.
ws and undici are imported by claude-code itself; string-width, wrap-ansi,
slice-ansi, strip-ansi, semver and yaml back Bun API shims in
files/bun-polyfill.cjs. wrap-ansi is called through a tab guard there: it
expands tabs where Bun does not, and the renderer's style offsets are
computed against the unexpanded string.
undici supplies EnvHttpProxyAgent, which the proxy path builds whenever
HTTP_PROXY or HTTPS_PROXY is set. Node has undici inside it but does not
let require() reach it, and the call is not guarded, so without this the
agent constructor threw and claude exited 0 having printed nothing at all:
every proxied user saw a silent no-op. The other proxy builder beside it
extends an https-proxy-agent bundled into the release and is unaffected.
strip-ansi is declared rather than left to arrive underneath string-width,
wrap-ansi and slice-ansi: the polyfill requires it directly for
Bun.stripANSI, so it is ours, and it would vanish the day all three of
those drop it.
ansi-styles is overridden to 7.x, past the ^6.2.3 that wrap-ansi and
slice-ansi still declare. Both use only its codes map and color.ansi(),
which 7.0 keeps; it adds SGR 59 (underline-colour reset) to the close
codes and new styles that stay out of that map. Across wrapping and
slicing of every style claude-code emits, output is byte-identical to
6.2.3; the only difference is in slicing passthrough text that carries
SGR 58, which slice-ansi mis-tokenizes under both, and 7.0 at least closes.
ts-morph was dropped on 2026-08-28. It had been declared since the port's
early days, but no release from 2.1.110 through 2.1.251 imports it, and it
is absent from upstream's own dependency list. Its only trace is a skill
script template (source-kit.mjs-*.txt) that does import { Project } from
'ts-morph' -- but that template runs from the user's project directory, so
it resolves against that project's node_modules, never ours, and the
wrapper sets no NODE_PATH. Removing it also drops @ts-morph/common,
code-block-writer, minimatch, brace-expansion, balanced-match,
path-browserify, tinyglobby, fdir and picomatch: 15.4 MB installed.
Restore it if a future release genuinely imports ts-morph, or if a skill
turns out to run those templates with our node_modules on the path.
